<script>
(function(){
  // Get the direct child UL.sub-menu of an LI (Safari-safe, no :scope)
  function getChildSub(li){
    var kids = li ? li.children : [];
    for (var i=0;i<kids.length;i++){
      if (kids[i].tagName === 'UL' && kids[i].classList && kids[i].classList.contains('sub-menu')) {
        return kids[i];
      }
    }
    return null;
  }

  // Wire one Divi mobile menu UL
  function wireOne(ul){
    if (!ul || ul.dataset.mmWired === '1') return;
    ul.dataset.mmWired = '1';

    // Start collapsed (CSS enforces too)
    ul.querySelectorAll('ul.sub-menu').forEach(function(s){ s.style.display=''; });

    // Use capture so we beat Divi's "close panel" handler; react on LI not <a>
    ul.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
      if (window.innerWidth > 980) return; // desktop: do nothing here

      // find the parent LI even if user taps spans, gaps, etc.
      var li = ev.target.closest('li.menu-item-has-children');
      if (!li || !ul.contains(li)) return;

      // ignore taps inside an already-open submenu's links
      var sub = getChildSub(li);
      if (sub && sub.contains(ev.target)) return;

      ev.preventDefault();
      ev.stopPropagation();
      ev.stopImmediatePropagation(); // avoid closing the whole menu

      // toggle only this LI
      if (li.classList.contains('submenu-open')){
        li.classList.remove('submenu-open');
        if (sub) sub.style.display = 'none';
      } else {
        li.classList.add('submenu-open');
        if (sub) sub.style.display = 'block';
      }
    }, true);
  }

  function scan(){
    // Your module ID first, fallback to any Divi menu
    document.querySelectorAll('#header-menu .et_mobile_menu, .et_pb_menu .et_mobile_menu')
      .forEach(wireOne);
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', scan);
  document.addEventListener('click', scan, true);         // covers hamburger tap
  window.addEventListener('resize', scan);
  window.addEventListener('orientationchange', scan);
  new MutationObserver(scan).observe(document.body, {childList:true, subtree:true});
})();
</script>
